title: Fixed-shape K1572 cardinal blocks have explicit continuum trace and fourth-mass limits

continuum_limits.block_class: Fix a conjugation-symmetric axis-aligned rectangular box C of positive side lengths inside the scaled cutoff, choose odd lattice side counts, and take the product real cardinal block on modes k/N in C.
continuum_limits.profile_functions: If kappa_(g,N)^+/N^2 tends to kappa_g, set b_g(xi)=sqrt(|xi|^2+kappa_g) and a_g(xi)=[2b_g(xi)]^(-1/2). Here b_g is the relative-score trace density and a_g is the physical field-covariance square-root multiplier.
continuum_limits.trace_limit: T_N/N^4 tends to tau_g(C)=int_C b_g(xi) dxi.
continuum_limits.fourth_mass_limit: L_N/N^4 tends to ell_g(C)=|C|^(-1) int_(C^3) a_g(x)a_g(y)a_g(z)a_g(x+y-z) 1_C(x+y-z) dxdydz.
continuum_limits.positivity: For every admissible positive-volume C, 0<ell_g(C)<infinity and 0<tau_g(C)<infinity.
continuum_limits.constant_cube_control: If C is a cube of side alpha and a_g=A, b_g=B are constant, then tau=B alpha^3 and ell=(8/27)A^4 alpha^6, reproducing the three-dimensional cardinal additive-energy constant.
continuum_limits.scope_guard: The limits use the repository's normalized Haar and k/N lattice convention and one fixed rectangular C. They do not cover general shapes, N-dependent localization, identify the best box, or construct a continuum probability state.
